default_rule: License an assertion only when the source directly entails the registered predicate and all normalized arguments under ordinary lexical meaning, with the same polarity, modality, and time. Do not add defeasible world knowledge.
normalization_rule: Lowercase Latin atoms preserve source identity but do not establish entity equivalence. Non-ASCII name transliterations remain provisional until an alias or identity decision is explicitly admitted.
